coarse_relation_firewall.statement: A nonzero class after quotienting only by retained marked-fiber principal relations is inconclusive: additional principal divisors on N may kill it.
coarse_relation_firewall.allowed_use: Retained principal relations may certify a displayed equality when they explicitly generate it; they may not certify nonprincipality without completeness.

minimal_source_locked_instance.purpose: Make the support-constrained Pic^0 leaf decidable by exact replay instead of another source search.
required: exact genus-one model N or exact Jacobian J
exact Abel-Jacobi images of every point used by the decision divisor
integer multiplicities of the decision divisor
source provenance and model-change data sufficient to replay all coordinates

accepted_reference_backend.point_encoding: null for identity, otherwise [rational_x,rational_y] with rational as integer or p/q string
accepted_reference_backend.verdict: exact elliptic-curve group sum of the declared degree-zero decision divisor

minimal_source_locked_instance.non_Q_or_other_model: Requires an exact backend plus an explicit source-locked change-of-model/Pic^0 map; do not coerce silently.

verifier_semantics.contract_only_without_instance: PASS means only that this closure contract is internally exact and source-locked; it is not an O210 verdict.
verifier_semantics.with_instance: PASS reports whether the exact declared group sum is the identity; only a source-locked instance matching the required support/divisor semantics can be promoted.
